notes: Opt-in crash reporting (off by default, self-hosted, scrubbed of secrets and traffic). Faster Shadowsocks and SSH (hardware AES-GCM). TUN mode: QUIC/UDP now flows through direct and SOCKS5 routes, plus per-app stats on macOS and a Share-on-LAN fix. macOS no longer shows a false 'authorization cancelled' error in TUN and Keychain secrets work there; the Windows tray no longer flashes a console window; the Default Proxy menu lists Direct, then Blocked, then your proxies.
